mascot.name: Nia
mascot.description: A joyful 6-year-old Black girl with two big round afro puffs tied with teal ties, warm brown skin, big bright eyes, a wide smile, bright yellow headphones with orange ear cups, and an orange shirt with a yellow collar and little yellow, teal and white polka dots. Flat 2D children's cartoon style, bold clean outlines, soft shading.
friends: Kofi - Nia's little brother, 4, short curly hair, green overalls, loves drums
Grandma Dot - Nia's grandmother, silver locs in a wrap, purple dress, plays keyboard
Beau - a fluffy golden puppy who dances

audience: Toddlers and preschoolers ages 1-6 and their parents
music_style: Modern kid-friendly hip-hop, R&B, gospel-pop, bounce, afrobeats and go-go grooves; clean, positive, singable choruses; bright child-like lead vocal with warm adult backing vocals; 90-130 BPM.
channel_description:
Welcome to Nia's Rhythm Room! 🎶 Sing, dance and learn with Nia, her little brother Kofi, Grandma Dot and Beau the puppy.

We make catchy, feel-good learning songs for toddlers and preschoolers — ABCs, numbers, colors, shapes, feelings, healthy habits, family and culture — set to the grooves grown-ups love too: hip-hop, R&B, gospel, bounce and afrobeats.

✨ New songs every Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

Made with love (and help from AI tools) for little learners everywhere. Subscribe and turn up the rhythm!
